objective: Review an on-device camera scanner feeding the existing exact offline GTIN candidate lookup.
owner_requirements: Preserve existing app/package data during in-place installation
All decoding must remain offline; no network permission, image storage, telemetry, or upload
A scan must populate the existing exact GTIN lookup, preserve all candidate provenance, and never arm an NFC write
implementation: CameraX preview and ImageAnalysis with one background analyzer thread
ZXing core 3.5.4 decodes only EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A, and ITF
Permission denial retains manual entry; lifecycle disposal unbinds analysis and stops its executor
A previous ML Kit prototype was removed after runtime telemetry scheduling attempts were observed
